mentions.name: EPUB linter
mentions.description: A linter for EPUB files that detects issues not covered by EPUBCheck or Ace by DAISY. It aims for speed, accurate diagnostics with exact problem start/end positions in the XHTML, clear issue descriptions including references, and output in the SARIF format.
mentions.problem: Existing EPUB linting tools (EPUBCheck and Ace by DAISY) don't cover certain EPUB issues.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on a linter for EPUBs for issues not covered by EPUBCheck/Ace by DAISY.

evidence.value: I am working on a linter for EPUBs for issues not covered by EPUBCheck/Ace by DAISY.
